"""Main: finite actual Runtime-queue properties, event capture and production GEMM fixture."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, fcntl, hashlib, importlib.util, json, math, os, re, selectors, time, traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
def module(name,p):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,p);v=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(v);return v
m=module('grouped_gpu_owner',O)
health=module('grouped_gpu_health',B/'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-v2.py')
mapping=module('grouped_gpu_mapping',B/'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v6/mapping.py');mapping.m=m
UTILITY=dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')
def ident(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--mode',choices=['free','contrib-llvm'],required=True);p.add_argument('--value',choices=['unset','0','01','true','1'],required=True);p.add_argument('--serial',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--debug',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--small',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args();assert 1<=a.serial<=3
 with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
  fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
  out=B/('main-prefill-leaf-service-fixture-'+a.mode+'-'+a.value+('-small' if a.small else '')+'-root-v'+str(a.serial));assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
  bp=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-build-root-v2/record.json';lp=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-root-v2/record.json';hp=B/('latest-update-main-integrated-v6-provider-health-xe-'+('startup' if a.debug else 'timed1-on')+'-root-v2/record.json')
  proof=json.loads(bp.read_text());lint=json.loads(lp.read_text());h=json.loads(hp.read_text())
  assert all(v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active'] for v in [proof,lint,h])
  assert proof['source_pins']==lint['source_pins'] and all(m.sha(W/name)==digest for name,digest in proof['source_pins'].items())
  binary=proof['builds'][a.mode]['fixture'];assert m.sha(binary['path'])==binary['sha256']
  assert h['boot_id']==Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()
  env=health.environment('xe','startup' if a.debug else 'timed1-on')
  if a.value != 'unset':env['STRATA_PREFILL_SERVICE_EVENTS']=a.value
  if a.small:env.update(STRATA_VRAM_LIMIT_MIB='8192',STRATA_MAX_ALLOC_MIB='4096',STRATA_NO_XMX='1')
  r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],source=ident(Path(__file__)),source_pins=proof['source_pins'],build_receipt=ident(bp),lint_receipt=ident(lp),startup_health=ident(hp),binary=binary,environment=env,boot_id=h['boot_id'],pci_bdf=health.PCI,scope='Actual Runtime queues, five pinned USM copy commands and production grouped GEMM; properties/correctness/event capture, no model speed/quality qualification.',raw_text_budget_bytes=64<<20,whole_wall_seconds=300,gpu_executed=False,reset_executed=False,retry_count=0)
  def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
  owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands;started=time.monotonic();cursor=None
  def run(label,args,chosen=UTILITY,interaction=None,wall=30):
   left=300-(time.monotonic()-started);assert left>0
   c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,chosen,out,interaction=interaction,wall=min(wall,left),cpu=1800 if interaction else 60,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=64<<20,total_cap=96<<20,file_cap=64<<20)
   r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout_sha256=m.sha(so),stdout_bytes=so.stat().st_size,stderr=se.read_text());save()
   assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
   return so.read_text(),se.read_text()
  def kernel(label,args):
   so,_=run(label,['/usr/bin/journalctl','-k','--no-pager','-o','json',*args]);rows=[json.loads(v) for v in so.splitlines()];assert len(rows)<=65536
   selected=[v for v in rows if health.PCI in v.get('MESSAGE','') or re.search(r'\bxe\b',v.get('MESSAGE',''))]
   faults=[v for v in selected if health.FAULT.search(v.get('MESSAGE',''))]
   r[label]=dict(relevant_entries=selected,fault_entries=faults,dump_present=health.DUMP.exists(),filter=health.FAULT.pattern);save();assert not faults and not health.DUMP.exists()
  def observed(io,entry):
   # Capture the actual live process's selected library mappings. Hash after owned normal exit;
   # mapping device/inode and stable path stats bind each captured mapping to those files.
   io.proc.stdin.close();last=0;seen=set();captures=[]
   with selectors.DefaultSelector() as ready:
    ready.register(io.proc.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
    while not io.exit_watch.poll(0) or not io.eof:
     io.poll()
     if not io.exit_watch.poll(0) and time.monotonic()-last>=.05:
      last=time.monotonic();now=m.identity(entry['pid'])
      if now and now['state'] not in ('Z','X','x'):
       assert now['start_ticks']==entry['direct_identity']['start_ticks']
       try:
        data,lines,selected=mapping.mapping_selection(entry,io.poll)
       except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):
        selected={}
       after=m.identity(entry['pid'])
       if selected and after and after['state'] not in ('Z','X','x'):
        key=tuple(sorted(selected))
        if key not in seen:
         assert len(captures)<32;seen.add(key)
         capture=dict(pid=entry['pid'],start_ticks=after['start_ticks'],monotonic=time.monotonic(),map_bytes=len(data),map_rows=len(lines),files={})
         for path,rows in selected.items():
          canonical=Path(path).resolve(strict=True);st=canonical.stat()
          for row in rows:
           major,minor=(int(v,16) for v in row[3].split(':'));assert st.st_ino==int(row[4]) and st.st_dev==os.makedev(major,minor)
          capture['files'][path]=dict(canonical_path=str(canonical),stat=mapping.stat_identity(canonical),mapped_rows=[' '.join(row) for row in rows])
         captures.append(capture)
     if ready.select(.02):io.read();io.pending.clear()
   r['live_mapping_captures']=captures;assert captures;save()
  try:
   kernel('kernel-before',['-b'])
   so,_=run('kernel-cursor',['/usr/bin/journalctl','-k','-n','0','--show-cursor','--no-pager']);hit=re.search(r'^-- cursor: (.+)$',so,re.M);assert hit;cursor=hit[1];r['kernel_cursor_before']=cursor
   so,_=run('device-selected',['/usr/bin/xpu-smi','discovery','-d','0','-j']);device=json.loads(so);assert device['pci_bdf_address']==health.PCI and device['device_state']=='normal';r['device_discovery']=device
   so,_=run('device-usage',['/usr/bin/xpu-smi','stats','-d','0','-j']);stats=json.loads(so);assert stats['pci_bdf']==health.PCI;used=stats['memory']['used_mib']['tile_0']['current'];assert type(used) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(used) and 0<=used<=256;r['device_used_mib_before']=used
   r['gpu_executed']=True;save();so,se=run('service-fixture',[binary['path']],env,observed,180)
   assert not re.search(r'UR_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST|ZE_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST|terminate called|\[FATAL\]|CELL status=FAILED',so+'\n'+se,re.I)
   found=[v for v in so.splitlines() if v.startswith('SERVICE_FIXTURE ')];assert len(found)==1
   cell=dict(v.split('=',1) for v in found[0].split()[1:]);assert cell['status']=='PASS'
   enabled=a.value=='1';assert int(cell['profiling'])==int(enabled) and int(cell['queues'])==3
   assert int(cell['copies'])==5 and int(cell['grouped'])==1 and int(cell['outputs'])==1280 and int(cell['canaries'])==16
   assert int(cell['overlap_rejected'])==int(enabled) and cell['reset_scope']==cell['zero_copy_excluded']=='1'
   summaries=[v for v in se.splitlines() if v.startswith('strata prefill service events: ')]
   categories=[v for v in se.splitlines() if v.startswith('strata prefill service category: ')]
   if enabled:
    assert len(summaries)==2 and len(categories)==3
    summary=[dict(v.split('=',1) for v in line.split(': ',1)[1].split()) for line in summaries]
    assert [int(v['captured']) for v in summary]==[6,0]
    assert all(v['status']=='complete' and v['checked_boundary']=='1' and all(v[k]=='0' for k in ['overflow','pending','invalid_timestamp','query_errors','excluded_graph','bookkeeping_failed']) for v in summary)
    parsed=[dict(v.split('=',1) for v in line.split(': ',1)[1].split()) for line in categories]
    if a.small:assert [v['backend'] for v in parsed if v['kind']=='grouped_gemm']==['DP4a']
    assert sum(int(v['count']) for v in parsed)==6 and sum(int(v['valid']) for v in parsed)==6
    assert sorted((v['kind'],int(v['count'])) for v in parsed)==[('grouped_gemm',1),('memcpy',1),('memcpy',4)]
    assert all(int(v['service_sum_ns'])>0 and int(v['service_min_ns'])>0 and int(v['service_max_ns'])>=int(v['service_min_ns']) for v in parsed)
   else:assert not summaries and not categories
   r['cell']=cell;r['service_summaries']=summaries;r['service_categories']=categories
   files={}
   for capture in r['live_mapping_captures']:
    for path,item in capture['files'].items():
     canonical=Path(item['canonical_path']);assert mapping.stat_identity(canonical)==item['stat']
     if path not in files:files[path]=dict(item,sha256=m.sha(canonical))
     assert mapping.stat_identity(canonical)==item['stat']
   assert env['UR_ADAPTERS_FORCE_LOAD'] in files
   for path,item in h['mapped_libraries'].items():
    assert path in files and item['sha256']==files[path]['sha256'],path
   r['actual_mapped_libraries']=files;r['mapping_scope']='Live same PID/start ticks mappings and device/inode matches; contents hashed and stable path stats rechecked after normal process exit.'
   kernel('kernel-after',['--after-cursor',cursor]);r['kernel_gate_passed']=True;r['complete']=True
  except BaseException as e:r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
  finally:
   if cursor and owner.active is None:
    try:kernel('kernel-final',['--after-cursor',cursor])
    except BaseException as e:r['kernel_gate_error']=repr(e)
   r.update(active=owner.active is not None,boot_unchanged=r['boot_id']==Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and r['boot_unchanged'] and not r.get('error') and not r.get('kernel_gate_error'));save()
  print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','cell','kernel_gate_error']}));return 0 if r['passed'] else 1
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
